- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:36-37 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The integrity job's 35-minute timeout leaves no headroom when the manifest fetch waits the full 25 minutes allowed by the 1500 s clamp and the other work takes the 10 minutes the comment allows for it.
  WHY: If the fetch waits the full time and the remaining work (attestation verify, compare, status publish) runs over 10 minutes, GitHub cancels the job at 35 minutes before failure_reason_code reaches the alert and Summary steps; the sibling update-wrappers job keeps 5 minutes of headroom at the same clamp. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high, with confidence 4 (openai_gpt-6-luna) and 3 (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 checked this issue and chose not to report it: it is not a regression from the base and it needs an operator override of 1500 or more.

  PROBLEM: The 35-minute job timeout leaves no headroom for the maximum 25-minute fetch wait plus the 10 minutes allocated to other work.
  WHY: If the fetch uses the full wait and the job's remaining work exceeds 10 minutes, GitHub cancels the job at 35 minutes before verification can finish or return its classified failure.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:lines 36-37 (with clamp at .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:318 and comment at update_workflows.yml:317 / workflow_integrity.yml:557) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: At the 1500 s clamp ceiling, the integrity job's comment allows 25 min of wait plus 10 min of work, which equals the full 35-min timeout with no headroom. The update-wrappers job keeps 5 min of headroom (update_workflows.yml:55-56), so the two budgets disagree. The last run fixed only the comment, not the allocation.
  WHY: An operator sets the variable to 1500 or more, the block sleeps about 1500 s and succeeds, and the post-fetch work (attestation verify, compare, status publish) runs over the remaining margin. The run is then cancelled at 35:00 before failure_reason_code reaches the alert and Summary steps. Suggested fix: raise the integrity job's timeout-minutes (e.g. 40) or reword the work estimate.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
